title: sim-run tests: a test fake xcrun can fall through to the real simctl, and a leaked test watchdog outlives its test, so a stranded test run polled the real simulator once a second (priority: this kind of leak fed the load spikes)
evidence: Found 2026-11-13 in review of PR 1435: a sim-run started by ios/scripts/sim-run.test.ts outlived its test (ppid 1); its temp dir with the fake xcrun was deleted, so PATH fell through to the real xcrun and its watchdog ran the real `simctl list devices booted` (both sets) about once a second until its run limit. Killed by hand. Fix: the test PATH must hold no real xcrun (a fake that refuses everything else, or PATH without /usr/bin xcrun), and each test must kill its sim-run process group in afterEach, so no watchdog outlives its test
